2117794798417408337.en_summary: Block $XYZ reaches a deal in principle with the DOJ for a ~$964M penalty over money laundering lapses, deferring a charge for 3 years.
2117794798417408337.zh_summary: Block $XYZ 與司法部就洗錢疏失達成約 9.64 億美元罰款的原則性協議，並將一項指控延後 3 年。

2117792939086856321.en_summary: Hinojosa, who wants to halt new data centers, is now an 80% favorite to lead Texas where 32% of all US data center construction is happening. Previously Abbott (R) at 60%+ odds was a factor in the rally of neocloud/AI landlord stocks like $HUT, $IREN, $RIOT.
2117792939086856321.zh_summary: 希望停止新建數據中心的 Hinojosa 目前有 80% 機會成為德州州長，而德州佔全美數據中心建設的 32%。此前 Abbott（共和黨）超過 60% 的勝算是新雲/AI 房東股票如 $HUT、$IREN、$RIOT 上漲的因素之一。

2117790136209457567.en_summary: $QQQ down 1.5%. Dems are sweeping right now. Even Texas is in play. Kalshi forecasts 56 Democratic Senate seats and gives Hinojosa a 79% chance of beating Abbott for governor. Only 16.6% counted in Texas, but those are brutal numbers for Republicans.
2117790136209457567.zh_summary: $QQQ 下跌 1.5%。民主黨目前正在橫掃。連德州也陷入競爭。Kalshi 預測民主黨將獲得 56 個參議院席位，並給予 Hinojosa 79% 的機會擊敗 Abbott 成為州長。德州僅計票 16.6%，但這些數字對共和黨而言非常不利。

2117783939016237388.en_summary: Trade plan for Wednesday: $AMD gapping higher after earnings and lifting semiconductor and AI stocks after hours. Looking for QQQ to close above 700 and $SPX above 7620 by Friday. $NBIS to 170 in play, $MU to 900, $SNDK to 1250 possible, if $SMH can hold above 525 this week we can see 550 next week.
